methodology.preferred_rule: Use the exact official board whenever it is available.
methodology.fallback_rule: A security proxy is an explicitly labelled observation aid, never a board-index replacement.
methodology.candidate_limit: Normally one ETF and one leader; a priority theme may show up to three leaders separately.
methodology.aggregation_rule: Do not calculate an equal-weight or other synthetic index by default.
methodology.admission_rule: Every candidate requires user review before any product integration. The formal registry does not read this file.

proxy_disclaimer: 代理证券用于观察主题相关标的表现，不代表官方板块指数或完整行业表现。
